Generic Write-In slots excluded. Two qualified write-ins remain separate in declared-write-ins.json. Three shared exact races reuse existing contest/candidacy IDs: WrightwoodCSD from LosAngeles and two water-agency/district races from Riverside; precise existing office provenance is retained. Standard Arial glyph mapping restored only in a disposable extraction copy; original native PDF unchanged.
